item.text: Inspecting the reconstructed 10-K JSON for the net income (loss) value in the most recent fiscal year, then I’ll return the document-supported figure only.

item.command: /bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"net income|net loss|net income \\(loss\\)|statement of income|consolidated statements of income\" /mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/ADOBE_2016_10K_reconstructed.json"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"net income|net loss|net income \\(loss\\)|statement of income|consolidated statements of income\" /mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/ADOBE_2016_10K_reconstructed.json"

/bin/bash -lc "jq -r '.texts[] | select(.text|test(\"Net income|Net loss|net income|net loss|CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF INCOME|Consolidated Statements of Income\"; \"i\")) | [.page_no, .text] | @tsv' /mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/ADOBE_2016_10K_reconstructed.json"

/bin/bash -lc "jq -r '.texts[] | select(.text|test(\"Net income|Net loss|net income|net loss|CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF INCOME|Consolidated Statements of Income\"; \"i\")) | [.page_no, .text] | @tsv' /mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/ADOBE_2016_10K_reconstructed.json"
